g.title: VIT
g.text: tubelet 2: the two frames make one 16×32 grid

g.title: TOK
g.text: tokens-vit-v1 · 1 MB a sample · 108 GB for navtrain

g.title: RAY
g.text: each token's ray at 16 depths, 1–60 m log-spaced
48 numbers → MLP 48 → 256 → d · 0.08 M · added to the keys

g.title: CA
g.text: q = a + pos · k = memory + rays · v = memory

g.title: QRY
g.text: learned · points start uniform in x 2–50, |y| < 30, z 0

g.title: SA
g.text: q = k = a + pos · v = a · pre-LayerNorm

g.title: HD
g.text: class: veh · ped · cyc · none (bias: p(none) ≈ 0.7)
Δreference → centre x y z (zero-init: starts at the reference)
box: log l, log w, log h, sin yaw, cos yaw
velocity vx vy (m/s, ego axes) · path: offsets at +0.5 s, +1.0 s

g.title: HD->POS
g.text: next layer's reference = this centre, detached

g.title: HUN
g.text: each target gets one slot; the other slots learn "none"

g.title: OUT
g.text: class = most likely of the three · path = centre + offsets

g.title: LOS
g.text: each divided by the batch's targets (path: by its valid steps)

g.title: TGT
g.text: veh · ped · cyc within 50 m whose centre projects into the image
nearest first, at most 64 · padded, with a mask
